name: discouragement
quote: I tried to fix the clock but gave up.
description: Disappointment and doubt about being unable to achieve a desired outcome and a growing readiness to give up.

variations.name: fear of shame
variations.description: If you perceive that there may be a loss of social status with a failure, discouragement may come with fear of shame.

commentaries.quote: Discouragement is the tail end of a process overcome by repeated frustration.
When you predict a failure, it can be difficult to attribute the appropriate of amount of self-blame.

conditions: After several attempts, you doubt that a task can be accomplished, when previously it was thought to be possible.
